terms.title: Terms of Use
leadParagraphs: These Terms of Use (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of this website and related enquiry tools operated for Suvarna Vridhhi Yojna by Pradeep Jewellers, Nadiad (“Pradeep Jewellers”, “we”, “us”, “our”, including authorised representatives). The website includes pages, text, images, videos, calculators, forms and other materials (together, “Content”).

Please read these Terms carefully before using the website. By accessing, browsing or submitting information through the website, you acknowledge that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please discontinue use immediately.
Nothing on this website constitutes jewellery purchase, investment advice or a binding offer to enroll in the scheme; enrollment is completed only at our store under separate documentation.

“User”, “you”, “your” means any person who visits the Website or submits an enquiry.
“Scheme” means the Suvarna Vridhhi gold accumulation / EMI-based savings programme offered by Pradeep Jewellers as described at the store and in enrollment documents.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
leadParagraphs: Pradeep Jewellers (“we”, “us”, “our”) respects your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, store and share personal information when you visit this website, use the enquiry form or interact with Suvarna Vridhhi-related communications.
By using the Website or submitting information, you agree to this Policy together with the Terms of Use. If you do not agree, please do not use the Website.

sections.heading: 1. Scope
paragraphs: This Policy applies to personal data processed through our promotional website and enquiry channels for Suvarna Vridhhi Yojna. In-store enrollment may involve additional notices and consent forms.

sections.heading: 2. Personal Data We Collect
paragraphs: Depending on how you interact with us, we may collect the categories described below. Providing data is voluntary; however, without certain fields we may not be able to respond to your enquiry.
bullets: Identity and contact details such as name and mobile number;
Enquiry details including preferred monthly installment amount and selected plan;
Technical data such as browser type, device identifiers, approximate location derived from IP address and pages viewed;
Communications with our team (call logs or messages where retained in accordance with law).

sections.heading: 3. How We Use Personal Data
paragraphs: We use personal data for the purposes listed below. We do not sell your personal data to third parties in the ordinary course.
bullets: Respond to enquiries and arrange callbacks;
Explain Suvarna Vridhhi plans and assist with store enrollment;
Send service-related or legally required notices;
Improve Website security, analytics and user experience;
Comply with legal obligations and protect our legitimate interests, provided those interests are not overridden by your rights.

sections.heading: 4. Legal Basis
paragraphs: We rely on your consent (where required), performance of steps prior to a contract at your request, compliance with legal obligations, and legitimate interests such as fraud prevention and communication regarding enquiries you initiate.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing and Disclosure
paragraphs: We may share personal data with trusted service providers who assist with hosting, messaging or IT security, bound by confidentiality and processing instructions.
We may disclose information if required by law, court order or government request, or to protect the rights, safety and property of Pradeep Jewellers, our customers or the public.

sections.heading: 6. Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal data only as long as necessary for the purposes above, including resolving disputes and meeting legal, accounting or reporting requirements. Enquiry records may be retained for a reasonable period unless you request deletion subject to applicable law.

sections.heading: 7. Security
paragraphs: We implement reasonable technical and organisational measures suited to the nature of our Website. No method of transmission over the Internet is completely secure; we encourage you not to share sensitive passwords where not requested.

sections.heading: 8. Your Rights
paragraphs: Depending on applicable law (including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 where applicable), you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data, withdraw consent where processing is consent-based, or lodge a grievance.
To exercise rights, contact us using the phone or store address listed on the Website. We may need to verify your identity before processing requests.

sections.heading: 9. Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: We may use essential cookies or local storage required for basic Website functionality. Any analytics or preference cookies will be used in line with applicable norms and your choices where required.

sections.heading: 10. Children
paragraphs: The Website is not directed at individuals under eighteen (18). We do not knowingly collect personal data from children.

sections.heading: 11. Updates to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The revised Policy will be posted on this page with an updated “Last updated” date. Please review periodically.

sections.heading: 12. Contact for Privacy Queries
paragraphs: For privacy-related questions or requests, contact Pradeep Jewellers using the phone number and address published in the “Visit Us” section of this website.
